subject: Ambiguous AWS metering ledger — allocation for untagged usage; EU/UK VAT split required
messages:
From: Jane Perez <jane.perez@acme-cloud.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing-ops@acme-cloud.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Clarification on Oct AWS Marketplace invoice (untagged usage)

Hi Sofia / Dylan —

Thanks again for the call last week. We pulled the October Marketplace invoice and noticed ~USD 18,273.50 in "untagged" metering that landed on the marketplace settlement line attributed to Redwood's publisher account. Acme believes some of that usage should have been routed under our reseller mapping (partner: ACME-Reseller) because those customer accounts are billed through our contract.

I've attached a short CSV extract (acme_awsmkt_untagged_usage_202610.csv) showing the resource ids, timestamps and the account mapping tags we observed. The invoice reference is Redwood-INV-202611-ACME (attached as a redwood_invoice_202611_draft.pdf stub).

Two asks: 
- Can Redwood confirm the logic used to allocate untagged metering when there is overlapping mapping between publisher and reseller?
- For the portion we agree should move to Acme, how will VAT/VAT reverse-charge be handled? Several of the end customers are EU-based, one is UK-based (preparing for post-Brexit handling).

We need an allocation and credit/adjustment plan before our month-end close on Nov 10. Can you confirm by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks,
Jane Perez
Billing Ops Lead, Acme Cloud
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Perez <jane.perez@acme-cloud.com>, billing-ops@acme-cloud.com
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarification on Oct AWS Marketplace invoice (untagged usage)

Hi Jane —

Thanks for the CSV and the invoice stub. I dug into our ledger extract and attached a short report (sofia_ledger_extract_20261101.csv) showing the raw metering events we received from AWS and how our routing rules applied. Quick summary: 

- ~USD 12.9k of the untagged rows appear to correspond to customer accounts that have a reseller mapping in our onboarding table but are missing the partner_tag on certain resource events (likely caused by a transient tagging race during provisioning). 
- ~USD 5.3k looks to be usage genuinely originated from publisher-side resources that Acme does not manage.

We think the correct remediation is: 1) reallocate the ~12.9k to Acme (generate a marketplace credit and update settlement routing for those resource ids), and 2) leave the 5.3k on the Redwood invoice. For VAT: 

- EU customers where Acme is the reseller: apply reverse-charge if the merchant/reseller VAT registration info is present; otherwise treat as standard VAT (we need VAT IDs).
- UK customer: treat per UK VAT rules (merchant must issue corrected invoice showing VAT charged at 20% or apply reverse-charge where valid).

Can Acme confirm the VAT registration numbers for the impacted EU accounts and confirm the single UK customer (account id: ACME-UK-001) in your CSV? If yes, we'll prepare the credit memo and a corrected invoice draft for your review.

Given your month-end, we can target: credit memo + draft reissued invoice by Nov 9, final by Nov 12. Will that work?

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Finance Manager — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marketplace Finance <marketplace_finance@amazon.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Clarification on Oct AWS Marketplace invoice (untagged usage)

Hi all,

Quick note from AWS Marketplace Finance: when metering events arrive without partner/reseller tags, the default is to attribute to the publisher account unless there's a validated mapping in the partner/reseller registry. We opened a support case (https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/home#cases/C-1234567890) and flagged the resource ids you provided.

To remediate on the marketplace side we need two things from Redwood and Acme: 
1) Proof of reseller mapping (subscription id <-> partner id) for the impacted subscription ids (screenshot or registry export is fine).
2) Confirmation of VAT handling preference (credit + reissue invoice showing corrected tax allocation OR credit + separate reseller invoice).

If both are provided, AWS can apply an adjustment to the settlement and re-run the allocation for October; timing typically 5–7 business days after validation. If Redwood issues an invoice-level credit internally and Acme invoices its customers directly, that's also acceptable but make sure to align on VAT mechanics.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Finance Team

Subject: Re: Clarification on Oct AWS Marketplace invoice (untagged usage) — remediation plan and owners

Team — quick status and action plan (consolidating AWS guidance + our ledger):

Summary: we agree to reallocate USD 12,926.40 to Acme (see line-level ids in attached CSV). USD 5,347.10 remains with Redwood. AWS confirmed they will accept a validated mapping export and will re-run allocation once we submit.

Action items: 
- Sofia: prepare Redwood credit memo (CR-RED-20261109) and attach redwood_invoice_202611_draft.pdf with corrected totals. Due: 2026-11-09 EOD.
- Marcus Lin (Ops): submit partner mapping export to AWS case C-1234567890 and request reallocation. Due: 2026-11-10.
- Dylan Brooks (Revenue): coordinate with Acme to confirm VAT registration numbers for impacted EU customers and verify ACME-UK-001 VAT handling. Due: 2026-11-10.
- Acme / Jane: confirm VAT IDs for EU accounts and confirm whether you prefer Redwood to reissue invoice with adjusted VAT lines or for Acme to invoice end customers (we will default to Redwood reissue unless you ask otherwise). Due: 2026-11-10.

Notes on VAT mechanics: 
- If Acme provides valid VAT IDs for EU B2B customers, Redwood will apply reverse-charge (no VAT) on the redistribution invoice lines. 
- For the UK customer, if Acme does not have UK VAT registration for the transaction, Redwood will reflect VAT at 20% on the corrected invoice and then Acme can seek reclaim if appropriate. 

I'll attach the draft credit memo and the reissued invoice once Marcus confirms the reallocation with AWS. Please flag immediately if any of the customer ids are incorrect — we will not finalize until we have sign-off.

Thanks —
Sofia
Finance Manager — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sofia_ledger_extract_20261101.csv, acme_awsmkt_untagged_usage_202610.csv, redwood_invoice_202611_draft.pdf
